data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error in Report 1 (qwen3-235b), which failed with 'HTTP 400, BadRequestError' when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD. coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen3-235b) failed to audit PKGBUILD due to LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), leaving the most critical file unaudited
learnings: When one model encounters a tool error (API failure, timeout, crash) on a critical file like PKGBUILD, the audit system should recognize this as a coverage gap rather than treating the result as a genuine 'inconclusive' security finding
Reports with tool errors on key files should be weighted against successful reports from other models that covered those files, rather than causing disagreement escalations
The audit tool should distinguish between 'model could not complete analysis due to infrastructure failure' and 'model completed analysis but found ambiguous results'
